property_summary: For any admissible input where the caller differs from callerConfirmation, renounceRole must revert in the reference C (AccessControlBadConfirmation), whereas the mutant removes this check and lets any caller complete the call without reverting; the test asserts a third-party renounceRole call reverts.
change_summary: Remove the check that the caller is the account being renounced, allowing any caller to renounce roles of other accounts.
